realesrgan-x4plus.notes: Baseline Real-ESRGAN photo model. Same family FreeScaler ships.

4xNomos8kSC.notes: 2023 ESRGAN photo model by Philip Hofmann. Trained for JPEG compression and slight blur.

ultrasharp-4x.notes: Kim2091 UltraSharp. Strong texture recovery. Non-commercial.

4xNomos2_otf_esrgan.notes: 2024 ESRGAN photo model. Real-ESRGAN on-the-fly JPEG and blur degradation. Exported from the author's safetensors. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, dynamic H/W). Graph: input[1,3,height,width]; output[1,3,height,width]. Real dog-photo crop max abs vs PyTorch: 5.63e-06 at 64, 7.39e-06 at 128.

4xRealWebPhoto_v4_dat2.notes: 2024 DAT-2 model for JPEG and web-compressed photos. Fixed 128×128 input; the runtime reflect-pads every tile to that size. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, fixed 128×128). Max abs vs PyTorch: 128:1.91e-06. Graph: input[1,3,128,128]; output[1,3,512,512]. Real dog-photo 128 crop max abs vs PyTorch: 5.19e-06.

spanx4_ch48.notes: Official SPAN 4x pretrain, 48 channels. Apache-2.0 from the SPAN release mirrored by OpenModelDB. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, dynamic H/W); export mirrors runtime 0–1 output clipping. Checked against PyTorch on real dog-photo crops: max abs 1.40e-06 at 64 and 1.73e-06 at 128.

scunet_color_real_psnr.notes: SCUNet blind real-image denoiser (PSNR checkpoint). 1x pre-step. Code Apache-2.0; weights from the KAIR v1.0 release. Fixed 128×128 input. ONNX exported locally with spandrel (opset 17, fixed 128×128). Max abs vs PyTorch: 128:1.37e-06. Graph: input[1,3,128,128]; output[1,3,128,128].

4xNomos2_hq_drct-l.notes: Large DRCT-L photo model. Disabled after fixed-128 tiled output retained severe square-grid artifacts; 48 px Hann overlap does not make its tile outputs consistent. The rebuilt 128-window-mask export matches PyTorch (max abs 1.07e-06 on a real dog-photo crop). Full-frame inference has not been validated under the 7 GiB service cap; a prior DRCT trace reached about 10 GiB.
4xNomos2_hq_drct-l.broken_reason: Severe square-grid artifacts persist with fixed 128×128 tiles and 48 px overlap; wider overlap is impractically slow. Full-frame DRCT-L has not been validated under the 7 GiB service cap; a prior DRCT trace reached about 10 GiB. Disabled until a correct low-memory inference path is available.
